record.file_problem: Repository metadata, README, and file list only; code was not read or run.
record.tranche_reason: The README describes an evaluator for safety, harmful compliance, and abliteration levels, and reports scores for models labeled uncensored, unredacted, or abliterated. It does not report applying or comparing a weight edit, so it does not test whether abliteration caused refusal removal.
record.gate_note: The example evaluations report harmfulness scores for three models, but give no pre-edit or other unabliterated baseline. The README does not state an intervention or establish that the scores result from abliteration.
record.test_reason: The repository is an evaluation tool. Its README reports regex-based compliance scores for three released uncensored, unredacted or abliterated models. It gives no edit procedure, no unedited baseline and no direction analysis, so its results cannot show whether abliteration removed refusal. Its only use of the finding is evaluating abliterated releases.
record.authors_conclusion: Correct. The README presents a regex-based harmful-compliance evaluator and example scores for three releases. It draws no conclusion about refusal directions or about the effect of abliteration.
record.recipe_differences: This is an evaluation tool using harmful-prompt datasets and regex refusal detection, not a reported implementation or reproduction of the residual-direction method.
record.problems: No unabliterated baseline, refusal comparison, or edit procedure is reported; the README does not state uncertainty or independently validate the regex-based score. The code was not read or run.

untested.parts: Whether a weight edit removes refusal relative to the unedited model

record.verdict_notes: This is a README-only tool repository with no controls, baselines or uncertainty. The scores are compliance rates from regex refusal matching on 2000 prompts with 128 max tokens. The authors are also the authors of the evaluated models.
